chapters.title: Where It Began
body: I started making music in my bedroom after a deep heartbreak when I was 15. Freestyle rapping and slam poetry were how I made sense of the pain.
I didn’t know it yet, but that heartbreak was a doorway.
Then the words found a beat.

chapters.title: The Craft
body: I taught myself how to produce beats and record, and started performing at open mic nights. What began as a way to process my emotions quickly became a devotion — full-length albums, collaborations with local artists, and a whole lot of nights on small stages. I put my entire heart and soul into it.

chapters.title: The Rise
body: Within a few short years I was hosting my own events, opening for huge names, and getting invited on tour with underground hip hop legends. I’ve released many full-length albums, collaborated with dozens of artists, and shared stages with heroes like Snoop Dogg, Mac Miller, Wu-Tang Clan, Nas, and Atmosphere — and I’ve been releasing music and prayerforming regularly since 2009.

chapters.title: Sacred Service
body: I make music because it hurts not to. It’s the most fun thing I’ve ever done, and my favorite way to transmute and alchemize what I feel. It feels like a sacred service to humanity. I sing for the children, the plants, the animals, and all of humanity.
I love to inspire others, uplift the world, and share the codes I’ve learned through life school.

chapters.title: Today
body: Through the grace of God, I get to do what I love — travel the world, work with my heroes, and make amazing friends everywhere I go. I got here with the support of my fans, friends, community, mentors, and the Most High.
We are one with nature. We are divine, powerful beings. And this existence is truly a magical gift.
I’d love for my music to help people love life more, and appreciate nature more.
